newsitem.title: UK: Orange shares off on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Orange shares off on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in mobile telephone company Orange Plc fell on Tuesday as investors cashed in on their gains from the stock's recent strong performance, traders said.
The stock was down five pence at 209p by 1240 GMT.
"There's profit-taking, they've had a good run," one trader said.
But some traders said the stock was still in demand and would bounce back.
"I suspect they're still going to rally," one market-maker said. "I think there's still a shortage of their shares in the market."
Orange shares have rallied since they hit a low of 169p on December 11.
